title: Natural-Language Routing on an Open Stack

s1.description: Why toggles aren’t enough, and the pattern: language becomes constraints, constraints become geometry.

s2.description: Five live requests from a phone at the Great Mall, Milpitas, each exercising a different open tool.

s3.description: Every route is checked independently of the planner.

s4.description: Where it breaks: data, engines, language, and the limits of constraints.
